guide.abyssia.abyss.title: The Abyss
guide.abyssia.abyss_1.text: The deep sea layer spans Y=-64 to Y=-376. Bedrock separates it from the ocean above; Deep Sea Fissures and Abyssal Rifts on the seafloor are the only ways in.
guide.abyssia.abyss_1.title: The Deep-Sea Layer
guide.abyssia.abyss_2.text: Long expeditions require preparation. Start by checking your surroundings in safer areas, gather resources, and move deeper step by step instead of rushing ahead.
guide.abyssia.abyss_2.title: Mind the Depth
guide.abyssia.abyss_3.text: The deep sea has many environments. Explore the Abyssal Plains, Hydrothermal Fields, Glowing Gardens, Sunken Ruins and more to find each place's scenery and resources.
guide.abyssia.abyss_3.title: Many Biomes
guide.abyssia.abyss_4.text: Deep-sea currents can push players, mobs, items, and boats. Watch which way the water moves while traveling, and be careful when dropping or collecting items.
guide.abyssia.abyss_4.title: Watch the Currents
guide.abyssia.abyss_5.text: Below Y=-376 lies the abyssal crust, solid rock. It is split by depth into bands B', C, D and E; the deeper you go, the rarer the ores and creatures. Follow caves and shafts to reach great water-filled halls lit by glowing rock and crystals. The bottom of the world is bedrock at Y=-1008.
guide.abyssia.abyss_5.title: The Abyssal Crust
guide.abyssia.abyss_6.text: The abyssal crust has zones of searing heat, freezing cold and toxic gas, stronger in deeper bands. Pressure gear or Fire Resistance protects against heat. Against cold, wear cold-proof armor or warm up near a hydrothermal vent. A diving helmet and tank keep out toxic gas, but the tank wears faster. Inside a submarine or a base you are safe.
guide.abyssia.abyss_6.title: Hazard Zones
guide.abyssia.base.title: Base Building
guide.abyssia.base_1.text: To keep working in the deep, build a base. The Habitat Constructor becomes usable with the Wreck Research technology.
guide.abyssia.base_1.title: Build a Deep-Sea Base
guide.abyssia.base_1b.text: Hold the Habitat Constructor and right-click or press G to open the build menu, then left-click to build. Press R or use the mouse wheel to rotate.
guide.abyssia.base_1b.title: Using the Constructor
guide.abyssia.base_2.text: Modules include foundations, rooms, corridors, entrances, moon pools and scan rooms; each is unlocked by research. Walls between neighbouring modules can be opened to join them.
guide.abyssia.base_2.title: Connect Structures
guide.abyssia.base_3.text: Completed base interiors contain air and are dry. Use them as safe working spaces for preparing equipment, supplies, and your next expedition.
guide.abyssia.base_3.title: Inside the Base
guide.abyssia.base_4.text: A Large Locker stores 81 stacks and can be named. The Wall Workbench crafts and charges items. There are also Charging Stations and aquariums. In a scan room you can upgrade the radar to scan a wider area.
guide.abyssia.base_4.title: Base Equipment
guide.abyssia.base_5.text: Materials are used as soon as construction starts. Cancelling returns them, but finished modules cannot be taken apart. Check the direction and connections before you build.
guide.abyssia.base_5.title: Building Caution
guide.abyssia.base_6.text: Base equipment draws on one power store shared by the whole base (up to 1,000,000 FE). Connect a cable from your generators to the base's outer wall to feed it.
guide.abyssia.base_6.title: Base Power
guide.abyssia.creatures.title: Creatures & Food
guide.abyssia.creatures_1.text: All kinds of creatures live in the deep. Defeat them for meat to cook or use in dishes. Scanning them with a Lidar Scanner also advances your research.
guide.abyssia.creatures_1.title: Deep-Sea Creatures
guide.abyssia.creatures_2.description: Meat obtained from a Deep Sea Shark. It can be cooked and used as food.
guide.abyssia.creatures_2.obtaining: Defeat a Deep Sea Shark to obtain it.
guide.abyssia.creatures_3.description: Cooked Deep Sea Shark Flesh made by cooking Deep Sea Shark Flesh. Use cooked meat as a prepared food source.
guide.abyssia.creatures_3.obtaining: Cook Deep Sea Shark Flesh to obtain it.
guide.abyssia.creatures_4.text: Deep-sea creatures can drop meat such as Deep Sea Shark Flesh. Meat can be cooked and can also be used for dishes. Gather food before your next trip.
guide.abyssia.creatures_4.title: Turn Meat into Food
guide.abyssia.creatures_5.description: One of the dishes available in Abyssia. Use prepared food to support your deep-sea expeditions.
guide.abyssia.creatures_5.obtaining: Gather Abyssia food ingredients and prepare them as a dish.
guide.abyssia.creatures_6.text: Sharks, giant squid and anglerfish inflict Pressure Fatigue, which slows you. Some jellyfish cause Cold Shock or Murk. Watch your gear and health when you get close.
guide.abyssia.creatures_6.title: Dangerous Creatures
guide.abyssia.diving.title: Diving Equipment
guide.abyssia.diving_1.text: Before diving into the deep, prepare your diving gear. There are three stages: entry, deep and pressure. Higher stages carry more oxygen and let you dive deeper.
guide.abyssia.diving_1.title: Prepare for Diving
guide.abyssia.diving_2.text: Entry Diver Helmet, Entry Dive Tank, Entry Diving Leggings and Entry Diving Flippers. The tank holds 5 minutes of oxygen and you are safe down to Y=-300. Start exploring the deep with this set.
guide.abyssia.diving_2.title: Entry Equipment
guide.abyssia.diving_3.text: Deep Diver Helmet, Dive Tank, Diving Suit Leggings and Abyssal Flippers. The tank holds 8 minutes of oxygen and you are safe down to Y=-800.
guide.abyssia.diving_3.title: Deep-Sea Equipment
guide.abyssia.diving_4.text: Pressure Diver Helmet, Pressure Dive Tank, Pressure Suit Leggings and Pressure Flippers. The tank holds 12 minutes of oxygen, water pressure no longer limits you, and the set resists searing heat. Crafting it needs the Pressure Gear technology.
guide.abyssia.diving_4.title: Pressure Gear
guide.abyssia.diving_5.text: Water pressure grows as you dive. Below your gear's limit you take damage and slow down. The limit is set by the weakest of your head, chest, legs and feet pieces: Y=23 with none, Y=-300 with entry gear, Y=-800 with deep gear, and no limit with pressure gear.
guide.abyssia.diving_5.title: Water Pressure
guide.abyssia.diving_6.text: Hold a Propulsion Screw and keep right-click pressed underwater to move forward. It runs on power (FE); charge it at a base's Wall Workbench or a Charging Station.
guide.abyssia.diving_6.title: Moving Faster
Combine a Book with a Deep Kelp Leaf.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia.title: Item Encyclopedia
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_1.description: An entry-level diving helmet. Worn with a dive tank, you breathe from the tank's oxygen underwater.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_1.obtaining: Prepare it as part of the entry diving equipment.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_10.descriptio: A base device used to scan the surrounding area. It is useful for checking your surroundings.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_10.obtaining: Place it as equipment inside a deep-sea base.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_11.descriptio: A generator that works near a hydrothermal vent, producing FE for industrial equipment.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_11.obtaining: Unlocked by the Thermal Survey technology.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_12.descriptio: An Energy Cable used to transfer FE power between equipment such as generators and machines.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_12.obtaining: Use it to connect equipment to the power network.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_13.descriptio: An industrial machine used for processing resources. It operates using FE power.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_13.obtaining: Place it as an industrial machine and connect it to power.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_14.descriptio: Place it and set a name and color to display a marker on screen from far away. The marker is hidden within 16 blocks.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_14.obtaining: Place it at a deep-sea base or another important location.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_15.descriptio: A planter that grows crops without water or power. It has four plots and crops grow in 3 minutes.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_16.descriptio: A blank map that records the seafloor when used in the deep sea layer.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_16.obtaining: Unlocked by the Deep Sea Map technology.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_2.description: An entry-level diving tank used as part of the basic diving equipment.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_2.obtaining: Prepare it as part of the entry diving equipment.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_3.description: Leggings of the entry diving set.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_3.obtaining: Prepare it as part of the entry diving equipment.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_4.description: Flippers of the deep diving set. Worn with diving leggings they give +40% swim speed and -50% current push.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_4.obtaining: Prepare it as part of the deep diving set.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_5.description: Helmet of the pressure set. Wear all four pressure pieces and water pressure no longer limits you.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_5.obtaining: Unlocked by the Pressure Gear technology.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_6.description: A propulsion device that lets you move faster underwater. It is useful when exploring large areas of the deep.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_6.obtaining: Prepare it as diving equipment and use it underwater.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_7.description: A device for constructing deep-sea bases. Hold it and press G to open the construction menu.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_7.obtaining: Usable once the Wreck Research technology is unlocked.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_8.description: A large storage unit for deep-sea bases. Use it to store supplies at your base.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_8.obtaining: Place it as equipment inside a deep-sea base.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_9.description: A wall-mounted workbench that provides crafting and charging inside a base.
guide.abyssia.encyclopedia_9.obtaining: Place it as equipment inside a deep-sea base.
guide.abyssia.industry.title: Industry & Power
guide.abyssia.industry_1.text: Abyssia industrial equipment uses FE as its power system. Start by preparing generation, then connect power so your machines can operate.
guide.abyssia.industry_1.title: Use FE Power
guide.abyssia.industry_2.text: There are hydrothermal, geothermal, current, biofuel and auxiliary generators, each unlocked by research. Place a hydrothermal generator near a hydrothermal vent. Energy storage blocks hold the power you make.
guide.abyssia.industry_2.title: Generating Power
guide.abyssia.industry_3.text: Connect equipment with Energy Cables or Reinforced Energy Cables. For distant places use Wireless Power Relays: placed within 128 blocks of another, they link automatically and send power without loss.
guide.abyssia.industry_3.title: Distribute Power
guide.abyssia.industry_4.text: Machines include the crusher, refinery furnace, alloy furnace, high-temperature furnace and selective leaching separator, all unlocked by research. The high-temperature furnace needs an active hydrothermal vent within 6 blocks.
guide.abyssia.industry_4.title: Use Industrial Machines
guide.abyssia.industry_5.text: The Hydro Planter needs neither water nor power; its four plots grow deep mushrooms, kelp seedlings and edible crops in 3 minutes. There are also powered tools such as the Electric Abyssal Drill and Electric Abyssal Cutter.
guide.abyssia.industry_5.title: Hydroponics and Tools
guide.abyssia.intro.book.desc: The book you are reading now. Open it whenever you are stuck to check the flow of the game and its items.
guide.abyssia.intro.book.obtaining: You receive one on your first login. If you lose it, craft one from a Book and a Deep Kelp Leaf.
guide.abyssia.intro.title: Introduction
guide.abyssia.intro_1.text: Abyssia expands the world beneath the sea into a deep-ocean environment. Start by heading into the depths, then gather resources and food to prepare for longer expeditions.
guide.abyssia.intro_1.title: Welcome to the Abyss
guide.abyssia.intro_2.text: The deep sea layer lies below a band of bedrock under the seafloor. Deep Sea Fissures and Abyssal Rifts on the seafloor are the ways in. Once you are through, look around and search for kelp, shellfish and ore.
guide.abyssia.intro_2.title: Your First Steps
guide.abyssia.intro_3.text: Deep rock gives cobblestone, and ores such as iron and copper can be mined by hand. When you find a wreck on the seafloor, scan it with a Lidar Scanner. It teaches you how to build a base.
guide.abyssia.intro_3.title: Gather First
guide.abyssia.research.title: Research and Scanning
guide.abyssia.research_1.text: New machines, buildings and recipes are unlocked by research. Hold a Lidar Scanner, look at a creature, plant, ore deposit or wreck and keep right-click pressed to scan it. Scanned things go into the database, and technologies unlock once their conditions are met.
guide.abyssia.research_1.title: Research by Scanning
guide.abyssia.research_2.description: A scanner that analyses creatures, plants, ore deposits and wrecks. Used on an ore deposit, it lists nearby deposits, nearest first, with size, remaining ore, direction and distance.
guide.abyssia.research_2.obtaining: Craft it at a crafting table.
guide.abyssia.research_3.text: Sunken wrecks hold a Wreck Core. Scan three to unlock the Wreck Research technology, which lets you use the Habitat Constructor and foundations. Scan five and research Alloy Smelting to unlock rooms and corridors.
guide.abyssia.research_3.title: First Research: Wrecks
guide.abyssia.research_4.text: Press K to open the research database. Its Creatures, Places, Resources and Technologies tabs show what you have scanned, and which scan targets and earlier technologies each technology needs.
guide.abyssia.research_4.title: Research Database
guide.abyssia.research_5.text: Technologies come in tiers Mk0, Mk1 and Mk2; higher tiers need targets from deeper bands. Start with shallow research such as Basic Metallurgy (an iron deposit) or Thermal Survey (a hydrothermal vent). The Scanner Mk1 and Mk2 technologies extend scan range and shorten scan time.
guide.abyssia.research_5.title: Technology Tiers
guide.abyssia.resources.title: Resources & Flora
guide.abyssia.resources_1.text: Ores such as iron, copper and gold can be mined by hand. Abyssia's own metals, such as cobalt and titanium, lie in ore deposits that only a Deep-Sea Excavator can mine.
guide.abyssia.resources_1.title: Deep-Sea Resources
guide.abyssia.resources_2.description: Raw ore from a cobalt deposit. Smelt it into a Cobalt Ingot.
guide.abyssia.resources_2.obtaining: Mine a cobalt deposit with a Deep-Sea Excavator Mk1.
guide.abyssia.resources_3.description: A Cobalt Ingot produced by smelting Raw Cobalt.
guide.abyssia.resources_3.obtaining: Smelt Raw Cobalt in a furnace or similar.
guide.abyssia.resources_4.text: Deep-sea rocks can provide cobblestone. Cobblestone can be used for furnaces and stone tools. Gather some whenever you find a useful rock deposit.
guide.abyssia.resources_4.title: Deep-Sea Rock
guide.abyssia.resources_5.text: Resource plants can be harvested when mature and will grow again afterward. Use them as renewable sources of materials and keep a steady supply ready for future expeditions.
guide.abyssia.resources_5.title: Grow Resource Plants
guide.abyssia.resources_6.text: Every ore deposit holds a limited amount. Once it is used up, its ore turns back into plain rock. Point a Lidar Scanner at a deposit to see its size and what is left, and set up your excavator at a large one.
guide.abyssia.resources_6.title: Deposits Run Out
guide.abyssia.resources_7.text: Place a Deep-Sea Excavator with the Habitat Constructor; it needs a 3x3x3 underwater space and power. Mk1 reaches 32 blocks and mines cobalt, titanium and more; Mk2 reaches 48 blocks and mines tungsten, platinum and more. Unlocked by Deposit Excavation and Deep Excavation.
guide.abyssia.resources_7.title: Deep-Sea Excavator
guide.abyssia.submarine.title: The Submarine
guide.abyssia.submarine_1.text: While aboard a submarine you never run out of air, and you travel the deep quickly. Research the Submarine technology to make the submarine and its dock. Place the dock inside a base's moon pool with the Habitat Constructor.
guide.abyssia.submarine_1.title: The Submarine
guide.abyssia.submarine_2.description: A power-driven submarine. Its battery holds 60,000 FE.
guide.abyssia.submarine_2.obtaining: Research the Submarine technology and craft it at a crafting table.
guide.abyssia.submarine_3.text: Steer with the mouse; W moves along the nose and S backs up. A and D move sideways, Space rises and Ctrl dives. G turns the lights on and off, and Shift gets out.
guide.abyssia.submarine_3.title: Piloting
guide.abyssia.submarine_4.text: Moving uses 8 FE/t and the lights 1 FE/t. In the dock it charges at 500 FE/t and its hull is repaired. Press Ctrl to leave the dock.
guide.abyssia.submarine_4.title: Power and the Dock
guide.abyssia.submarine_5.text: Upgrade with the Pressure Hull, High-Capacity Battery, Maneuver Thruster, Deep-Sea Sonar and Depth Hull Mk1 to Mk3. Depth hulls let it dive deeper; going below its limit damages the hull. The sonar shows nearby creatures, currents and docks on the HUD.
guide.abyssia.submarine_5.title: Upgrades
guide.abyssia.survival.title: Survival Basics
guide.abyssia.survival_1.text: Without gear you hold your breath for 2 minutes. A diving helmet plus a dive tank lets you breathe from the tank: 5 minutes with entry gear, 8 with deep gear, 12 with pressure gear. The tank refills above water, and breathing from it uses no durability.
guide.abyssia.survival_1.title: Manage Your Breath
guide.abyssia.survival_2.description: A useful food for deep-sea exploration. Carry enough food so you can stay prepared during an expedition.
guide.abyssia.survival_2.obtaining: Prepare food through cooking and other food sources, then bring it with you on expeditions.
guide.abyssia.survival_3.text: Deep-sea creatures can provide meat when defeated. Gather the meat, cook it when needed, and use prepared dishes to keep your expeditions going.
guide.abyssia.survival_3.title: Secure Your Food
guide.abyssia.survival_4.text: When your remaining breathing time gets low, consider turning back instead of going deeper. Gather food and resources, improve your equipment, and return for another expedition.
guide.abyssia.survival_4.title: Know When to Return
guide.abyssia.waypoints.deep_maps.text: Use a Deep Sea Map when exploring the deep sea. When used in the deep sea layer, it records the seafloor that cannot be seen on ordinary maps. Water depth and changes in seafloor elevation are shown through map shading. When looking for a way into the deep sea, use an Abyss Chart. It searches for a nearby entrance and marks its location on the map. If no entrance can be found, the chart is not consumed. The map is unlocked by the Deep Sea Map technology and the chart by the Abyss Chart technology.
guide.abyssia.waypoints.deep_maps.title: Deep Sea Maps
guide.abyssia.waypoints.title: Waypoints & Exploration
guide.abyssia.waypoints_1.text: Long expeditions can make it difficult to find your way home. Place a Waypoint Beacon to mark your base or other important locations before exploring farther.
guide.abyssia.waypoints_1.title: Avoid Getting Lost
guide.abyssia.waypoints_2.text: Place a Waypoint Beacon and give it a name and color. Its marker appears on screen from far away, but the marker is hidden within 16 blocks.
guide.abyssia.waypoints_2.title: Set a Name and Color
guide.abyssia.waypoints_3.text: Mark your base and important locations so you can travel farther into the deep with confidence. Prepare equipment, food, and resources before exploring unknown areas.
guide.abyssia.waypoints_3.title: Explore Farther
